summary: Frontend-only smoke test of integrated Event-Setups in the KI-Trader-Setups tab (iteration 10). Backtester modal now has exactly 2 tabs (Strategien, KI Trader · Setups) - the separate Events tab has been removed. On the KI-Trader tab the event-seed-section is visible with all 5 chips (fomc/cpi/nfp/ppi/pce), CPI and NFP already show validated backtests in the event-seed-table, CPI status is 'Edge bestätigt (validiert)' in green. Empty run (no class + no event) did not start any job. Event-only run with just CPI selected successfully triggered /api/event-setups/backtest, event-seed-progress appeared, job completed in ~35s with success toast, and no ai/playbook job was started (as expected). Admin live-toggle for CPI works (final state left OFF as required).

ui_bugs.issue: The live checkbox reflects the server-fetched state (ev.live_enabled) rather than local optimistic state. On rapid consecutive clicks the checked attribute temporarily shows the stale (pre-toggle) value until the next overview poll returns, which can confuse users into thinking the click did not register. Final state was correct after settle, so functionally safe but UX/perception issue.

action_items: Optional UX: make the live-toggle checkbox optimistic (update local state immediately, roll back on API error) so rapid toggles feel responsive.
critical_code_review_comments: AITraderSeeding.js is 437 lines and mixes many concerns (manual run, auto config, history table, results table, event ref delegation) - consider splitting the automation/history block into its own component (>700-line-heuristic not yet exceeded but growing).
AITraderSeeding.js lines 156-164 contain a duplicated paragraph about 'Mindest-Trades adaptiv' inside the intro <details> - one block should be removed.
seed_data_creation: none - re-used existing validated CPI/NFP backtests; triggered one live CPI event-backtest run (~35s) which refreshed the CPI row.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backtester modal now has 2 tabs only. Event-Setup chips + result table live inside AITraderSeeding via EventSetupSeeding (forwardRef exposing getSelected/start/isRunning). Main run button in ai-seed-run first delegates to eventRef.start() when any event chip is selected, then only starts the class backtest if classes are selected. localStorage key 'bt_ui_state_v1' maps saved tab 'events' -> 'ai'. Toast library uses a custom container, generic '.toast, [role=alert]' selectors did not pick up toast text in this run but toasts render (verified visually).
rca of the issue: Live-toggle stale-UI: onChange handler calls fetch and then load() to re-fetch overview; the checked prop is bound to ev.live_enabled from server state, so between click and successful re-fetch the input still shows the old value. Fix: keep an optimistic local override map, e.g. useState liveOverride[key] applied over ev.live_enabled until the next overview response confirms it.
